# HUNDESALON NIKA

HUNDESALON NIKA is a professional pet grooming salon in Leipzig, Germany. The site serves clients in German, English, Russian, and Ukrainian. The canonical public domain is https://hundesalon-nika.com/.

## AI agent routing

Coding agents must follow repository instructions in `AGENTS.md` and `docs/agents-routing.md` (startup detection, decision pipeline, module scope). Never guess the repository or hosting target.

## Language Routing

The root URL redirects visitors to a language version using Accept-Language first and Cloudflare country data as a fallback. The default language is German.

## Crawling Notes

Public marketing, service, price, booking, gallery, contact, and blog pages are intended for indexing. Internal tool paths and Cloudflare Functions are not public content.
